app.title: Baidu released ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base
app.author: pretext
app.description: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base is a large multilingual language model released by Baidu, optimized for faster inference with Flash Attention.
proposed_tests: Download the checkpoint weights from the release page
Load the model using the Hugging Face Transformers library
Run a forward pass on a sample prompt and record latency
Compare the output token distribution to a baseline GPT model
